Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
Hi there !
so now it's illegal to contest my own cards.
I hve 2 vamps ready : Anson and Anneke with the soul gem on her.
question 1 : Anneke is burned in combat. soul gem triggers. next vamp in the
crypt is anson. He is put in play... How is the contest handled ??
Question 2 : I put Vast wealth on Anson. he takes the aciton to equip with
... the soul gem. What happens ?
Question 3 : I'm contesting the soul gem with a vamp controlled by another
methuselah. I play "Temptation of Greater Power" thanks to Anneke. I gain
control of that vamp. How is the contest handled ?

I may think if you contest by accident, you'll use the old rules... am i
wrong ?

reyda

burned.

"simply burn the incoming copy of the unique card."

>Question 2 : I put Vast wealth on Anson. he takes the aciton to equip with
>... the soul gem. What happens ?

Same again.

>Question 3 : I'm contesting the soul gem with a vamp controlled by another
>methuselah. I play "Temptation of Greater Power" thanks to Anneke. I gain
>control of that vamp. How is the contest handled ?

From "simply burn the incoming copy of the unique card" I would be
tempted to rule that you burn the copy on the vampire you just stole.

LSJ may want to review this for consistency.

In article <9g37mr$4bk$1...@hadron.noos.net>, Reyda <re...@noos.fr> wrote:
>Hi there !
>so now it's illegal to contest my own cards.
>I hve 2 vamps ready : Anson and Anneke with the soul gem on her.
>question 1 : Anneke is burned in combat. soul gem triggers. next vamp in the
>crypt is anson. He is put in play... How is the contest handled ??

The incoming Anson is burned. It's unclear if this re-triggers the Gem, but
I think it does.

>Question 2 : I put Vast wealth on Anson. he takes the aciton to equip with
>... the soul gem. What happens ?

As with finding a Sport Bike when you already have one, the new Gem is
burned and you've wasted an action.

>Question 3 : I'm contesting the soul gem with a vamp controlled by another
>methuselah. I play "Temptation of Greater Power" thanks to Anneke. I gain
>control of that vamp. How is the contest handled ?

Hm. I think the incoming Gem is burned, but given that it's already contested,
I'm not sure. I'll let LSJ handle that one.

>I may think if you contest by accident, you'll use the old rules... am i
>wrong ?

Yep. The rule says if you contest with yourself through some tricky
control transfer mechanism or suchlike, the incoming copy is burned.

gomi

Messages.Author: MadCat
Messages.Body:
Vamp A blleds Methuselah controlling Vamp B. B (untapped) attempts to block
and A plays superior Faceless Night (tapping B).
The question: is B allowed to use a Deflection at this time (even if
tapped)?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Seems this question was answered very recently, actually.

B is also allowed to play, for instance, a +intercept reaction card.
This is because FN doesn't tap B immediately (which would preclude
him from blocking or playing +intercept or any other reaction). B
is tapped only when his controller announces "I don't block" or
when some other block is successful.

--
